definitions.explanation: A financial account held at a bank for depositing and withdrawing money.

examples.japanese: {銀行口座|ぎんこうこうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{銀行口座|ぎんこうこうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What do you need to open a bank account in Japan?

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{銀行口座|ぎんこうこうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧。
examples.english: Salary is deposited into the bank account every month.

notes:
A practical compound word that learners in Japan will encounter frequently. In everyday conversation, people often shorten it to just ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧ when the banking context is already clear.
